run_benchmark: run the benchmark script with a task config YAML to evaluate a forward-only agent over 10 episodes
create_ForwardOnlyAgent: create a ForwardOnlyAgent subclass of habitat.Agent that always returns the move_forward action
run_habitat_Benchmark_evaluate: run habitat.Benchmark with a task config and evaluate an agent across multiple episodes to get metrics
run_HabitatSimActions_move_forward: run the HabitatSimActions.move_forward action to move the agent forward in the simulation environment
review_ForwardOnlyAgent_act: review the ForwardOnlyAgent act method that returns a move_forward action dict for each observation
